environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8.0 service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an internal ALB (scheme: internal) within a private VPC (10.200.0.0/16). The ALB security group (sg-0a4f8e2c1b) has inbound rules allowing TCP/443 only from sg-0b7d3f9a2e (the API gateway tier SG) and 10.200.64.0/20 (operations subnet). The ECS task security group allows inbound only from the ALB SG. There is no internet-facing ingress path; the service is reachable exclusively through the internal API gateway which itself validates requests against an OAuth2 scope (inventory:write) issued only to the warehouse management system service account. Route53 private hosted zone resolves the service name only within the VPC. NAT gateway provides egress-only internet access for the tasks. VPC Flow Logs confirm no unexpected source IPs have reached the ALB in 90 days of operation.

config.dns: Route53 private hosted zone, no public resolution
config.api_gateway_auth: OAuth2 scope inventory:write, issued to wms-service-account only
